يستأنسوا (form X)
# يَسْتَأْنِسُوا (yastaʔnisū) /jas.taʔ.ni.suː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَأْنَسَ (istaʔnasa)
# يُسْتَأْنَسُوا (yustaʔnasū) /jus.taʔ.na.suː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَأْنَسَ (istaʔnasa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
